sources.title: NFL Draft's most fascinating prospect might be Caleb Banks, a 'planet theory' specimen who struggles with 1 major thing
sources.description: People shouldn't be able to move like Florida DT Caleb Banks at 6-6 and 327 pounds. That's a profile you bet on — but it's not without a pretty big on-field red flag.
